wire.operator_setup.prompt.confirm_phone.role: Operating-system administrator prompt reason (macOS shows it inside the system password dialog)
wire.operator_setup.prompt.confirm_phone.note: Shown by the OS itself next to the password field, so the person sees WHY their computer password is asked for. One sentence. 'Local Operator' is the product name: keep it. Must not mention Radient: this is the computer's own password.

wire.operator_setup.body.phone_approvals.note: Sits under the 'Turn on phone approvals' button. 'approve requests' = say yes to things the agent asks permission for.

wire.operator_setup.tui.usage.role: Terminal app usage line for the /mobile approvals command
wire.operator_setup.tui.usage.note: '/mobile approvals on' is a typed command: keep it exactly, untranslated.

wire.operator_setup.tui.starting.role: Terminal app progress line shown just before the computer's password prompt

wire.operator_setup.tui.anchor_clause.role: Clause appended to an approval-mode remedy sentence when phone approvals are not set up on this computer
wire.operator_setup.tui.anchor_clause.note: Starts with '; but' because it continues a previous sentence about two ways to change the approval mode ('neither' refers to those two). Keep 'Settings → Phone access' as the app's menu path and '/mobile approvals on' exactly as typed. No trailing period: the caller ends the sentence.
